prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Control your pet's desktop overlay position, visibility toggles, and screen behavior right here before starting.", "Desktop Overlay Toggles", "Launch Companion onto Desktop"]
1: ["Design Your Custom Desktop Pet", "Upload photos to generate your custom pet avatar with full photo framing tools.", "Upload Pet Photo", "Live Avatar Preview"]
2: ["Learn Companion Shortcuts", "Try hiding your pet with Alt+H or calling them back with Alt+C.", "Interactive Shortcut Trainer", "Complete Practice"]
3: ["Sign In & Cloud Save Your Pet", "Your companion and custom traits will be safely synced to your account so you never lose your progress.", "Automatic Cloud Save Enabled"]
4: ["Generating Your Desktop Companion", "We are preparing high-res sprite animations and system tray integration.", "Compilation Progress", "Did you know? You can drag your pet anywhere on your desktop screen once ready."]
5: ["Meet Your Desktop Workmate", "Desktop pets react to your work breaks, play idle animations, and stay by your side all day.", "Choose Your Journey"]
6: ["Tip: Standard pets launch instantly on all screens; custom photo pets require clear lighting.", "Select a companion style below to preview desktop behavior."]
7: ["Pet Successfully Placed on Desktop!", "If your pet is hidden, check your system tray/taskbar icon or press Ctrl+Shift+P to reveal it instantly.", "Click the taskbar pet icon anytime to open companion settings."]
8: ["Includes Free Starter Accessories"]
9: ["Cloud Recovery Guaranteed"]
